result.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Toolmaker – Moulding to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, refurbishment, modification, and manufacture of moulding tools and equipment used in production. This role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and a commitment to quality and safety.

Monday - Friday, 6:00am - 2:30pm
$40 - $45 per hour

Key Responsibilities
Manufacture, assemble, and fit precision mould tools, components, and fixtures.
Perform maintenance, repair, and modification of existing moulds to ensure optimal performance.
Read and interpret technical drawings, CAD files, and engineering specifications.
Collaborate with engineering, production and maintenance teams to troubleshoot tooling and moulding issues.
Conduct testing and commissioning of new mould tools.
Ensure moulds meet required tolerances and quality standards.
Operate toolroom machinery such as manual and CNC machines including lathes, milling machines, grinders, EDM and drilling equipment.
Perform preventative maintenance and ensure tooling is production ready.
Identify process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintain accurate records of tool modifications, repairs, and maintenance schedules.
Follow workplace health and safety regulations at all times.

Qualifications, Experience and Skills
Trade qualification in Toolmaking, Fitter & Turner, or equivalent.
Proven experience in mould manufacture, maintenance, refurbishment, and repair making, preferably
           in injection moulding, blow moulding, die-casting, or similar manufacturing processes.
Strong knowledge of machining processes (CNC, milling, turning, grinding, EDM).
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
High attention to detail and precision.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience with CAD/CAM software (desirable).
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
General Construction Induction Certificate (Blue/White Card)
Current Working at Heights and Confined Space tickets
Current valid Driver’s license

result.description:
Our valued client Metal Recovery Industries based in Rockhampton Qld, is seeking qualified Welders with industry experience to work in their busy workshop.

The Company collects, salvages and processes scrap metal goods for recycle and re use in regional and remote areas in Central North Queensland, including mining sites.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
